blocks.text: Şimdiye kadar şu an olanı söyledin: I am at home. Şimdi ne olduğunu anlatmayı öğreneceksin: «dün evdeydim», «Noel'de birlikteydik», «çantada iki mandal vardı». Bunun için bağlayıcının geçmiş biçimi var.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
We were together at Christmas.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
Was it warm in spring?

blocks.text: Türkçede geçmiş «-di» ekiyle yapılır: «evdeydim». İngilizcede bağlayıcının iki geçmiş biçimi var. am ve is yerine was: I was, she was. are yerine were: you were, we were, they were. Sıra aynı kalır: kim + was + yer.

examples.en: I was at home yesterday.
She was in London last year.
We were at home last night.
They were in London at New Year.
The hairdresser was busy yesterday.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday I home.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I were at home yesterday.
fixes.right: I was at home yesterday.

fixes.wrong: We was at home last night.
fixes.right: We were at home last night.

sections.title: Geçmiş işaretleri: yesterday, last night, on Sunday

blocks.text: Cümlede genelde geçmişi gösteren bir kelime olur: yesterday — «dün», last night — «dün akşam», last year — «geçen yıl». Bayramlar at ile: at Christmas, at New Year. Günler on ile: on Sunday.

examples.en: I was at home on Sunday.
We were together at Christmas.
They were in London at New Year.
The sports centre was closed yesterday.

fixes.wrong: I was at home in Sunday.
fixes.right: I was at home on Sunday.

fixes.wrong: We were together in Christmas.
fixes.right: We were together at Christmas.

blocks.text: Dünden bahsediyorsan was ya da were. Şu andan bahsediyorsan is ya da are, eskisi gibi. yesterday ya da now kelimesi hemen söyler: Yesterday my towel was wet. The shower curtain is dry now.

examples.en: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.
Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.
The shower curtain is dry now.
The bathroom mirror was dirty yesterday.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
fixes.right: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday my flip-flops was dirty.
fixes.right: Yesterday my flip-flops were dirty.

drill.question: Dün havlu ıslaktı. Nasıl söylersin?
drill.optionA: Yesterday my beach towel is wet.
drill.optionB: Yesterday my beach towel was wet.

blocks.text: 4. dersteki gibi, tane tane sayılmayan şeyler — krem, yemek, meyve suyu — tekil biçimi alır: was, were değil. Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

examples.en: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.
The apple juice was cold yesterday.
The hot chocolate was too sweet yesterday.

fixes.wrong: Yesterday the sun cream were in my bag.
fixes.right: Yesterday the sun cream was in my bag.

fixes.wrong: The baby food were in the cupboard.
fixes.right: The baby food was in the cupboard.

blocks.text: Türkçede olumsuzluk ekin içindedir: «değildi». İngilizcede not, was ya da were'den hemen sonra gelir: It was not my day off. The fried egg was not cold.

examples.en: It was not my day off.
The fried egg was not cold.
The peanut butter was not on the table.

fixes.wrong: It not was my day off.
fixes.right: It was not my day off.

fixes.wrong: The fried egg didn't cold.
fixes.right: The fried egg was not cold.

blocks.text: Türkçede soru «mıydı?» ekiyle sona gelir. İngilizcede was ya da were başa geçer: Was it warm in spring? Were you at home in autumn? Kısa cevap da bağlayıcıyla: Yes, it was. do ve did burada yok.

examples.en: Was it warm in spring?
Were you at home in autumn?
Was your pancake hot?
Were the scrambled eggs hot?
Yes, it was.

fixes.wrong: It was warm in spring?
fixes.right: Was it warm in spring?

fixes.wrong: Were your pancake hot?
fixes.right: Was your pancake hot?

fixes.wrong: Yes, it did.
fixes.right: Yes, it was.

blocks.text: Türkçede «vardı» sona gelir: «çantada iki mandal vardı». İngilizcede başa gelir: 4. dersteki there is'teki is, was olur. Bir şey için There was, birkaç şey için There were.

examples.en: There was a bed sheet on the bed.
There were two clothes pegs in the bag.
There was a public toilet near the station.
There were two taxi drivers near the station.
There was fruit salad in the bowl.

fixes.wrong: Two clothes pegs there were in the bag.

fixes.right: There were two clothes pegs in the bag.

blocks.text: was ile geçmişi değerlendirmek kolaydır: That was a silly idea — «aptalca bir fikirdi», The plan was sensible — «plan mantıklıydı». Birkaç şey için were: The rules were fair.

examples.en: That was a silly idea.
The plan was sensible.
The rules were fair.

blocks.text: Dersin bütün yeni dilbilgisi iki biçim: was — I, he, she, it ve tek şey için; were — you, we, they ve birkaç şey için. Gerisi am, is, are ile aynı.
-di — was ya da were. Değildi — was not, were not. Soru — Was…? Were…?, cevap — Yes, it was. Vardı — There was / There were, başta. Dün — was, şimdi — is.

examples.en: She was in London last year.
It was not my day off.
Were you at home in autumn?
There was a soap dish next to the washbasin.
